Trusted by + 0 Students Trainings Conducted 0 + Companies Tie-Ups 0 + Students Placed 0 + Corporate Training 0 + Course Overview Advanced Certification in React JS Web Development Eligibility 10+2 with Mathematics Duration 6 Months Student Work Load 750 Hrs The Advanced Certification in React JS & Angular Web Development by 3RI Technologies , we offers a comprehensive learning experience in front-end technologies. The course centers around Angular and React JS, equipping you to create dynamic, responsive web applications. Through hands-on projects and real-world examples, you will develop practical expertise, all while learning from seasoned industry professionals. This program covers everything from basic principles to advanced strategies, ensuring you are well-prepared for a successful career in web development. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced developer, this certification opens doors to exciting opportunities in the rapidly growing front-end development landscape. Enroll Now Download Syllabus Why Learn React.js and Angular Web Development? Vast Career Opportunities : Learning both React.js and Angular opens the door to a wide range of opportunities in the web development field. These are two of the most sought-after technologies in the industry, making you highly desirable to employers across various sectors, from startups to large enterprises. Mastering High-Performance User Interfaces with React.js : React.js, recognized for its component -based design, enables developers to construct dynamic and responsive user interfaces. Its flexibility and efficiency make it the go-to choice for building high-performance applications, especially those requiring real-time updates or interactive user experiences. Building Large-Scale Applications with Angular : Dependency injection and two-way data binding are just two of the many capabilities that Angular’s powerful structure offers. Besides, it is widely adopted for building large-scale applications, making it a crucial tool for developers aiming to work on complex, enterprise-level projects. Expertise in Both Frameworks : This course equips you with in-depth knowledge of both React.js and Angular, enabling you to handle a diverse range of web development projects. You will evolve into a versatile developer, able to easily adjust to varying project requirements. Rising Demand and Career Advancement : As the demand for React and Angular continues to grow, companies are actively seeking professionals with expertise in both frameworks. By mastering these technologies, you will be well-positioned to contribute to modern web development projects and advance your career as a skilled front-end developer. Why Choose React JS & Angular? Dynamic and Interactive Web Applications: Angular and React JS are the leading frameworks for building modern, user-centric web applications. With their advanced features and functionalities, you can create immersive experiences that resonate with your audience. Industry-Leading Frameworks: These frameworks are widely adopted by leading tech companies, making them highly sought-after skills in the job market. You will establish yourself as a valuable member of any programming team by becoming proficient with Angular and React JS courses in Pune. Career Advancement: The demand for skilled Angular and React JS developers is constantly growing. With our advanced certification, you will gain the expertise needed to advance your career and secure high-paying roles in the tech industry. Key Features Comprehensive Curriculum: The program covers a wide range of essential front-end technologies, including Angular and React JS courses in Pune , providing a complete learning experience from basic concepts to advanced techniques. Industry-Relevant Skills: Master the latest front-end tools and frameworks, equipping you with the essential skills to thrive in today’s web development landscape. Hands-on Learning: Immerse yourself in practical, project-oriented training that enables you to translate theoretical knowledge into real-world web application development. Expert Guidance: Receive valuable insights and personalized mentorship from experienced industry professionals during the course. Certification: Earn a prestigious Advanced Certification in React JS & Angular Web Development. Career Advancement: Boost your career with an in-demand certification and acquire the skills that leading tech companies are looking for. Collaborative Learning Environment: Participate in a dynamic, interactive learning experience where you can collaborate with peers and build valuable industry connections. Skills You will Gain After Training React JS Fundamentals: Grasp the essential concepts of React JS, including state , components, props, and JSX. Advanced React JS: Explore advanced topics such as hooks, the context API, and strategies for optimizing performance. Angular Fundamentals: Learn the basics of Angular, including components, directives, and services. Advanced Angular: Dive into advanced Angular functionalities such as forms, routing, and dependency injection. Front-End Development Best Practices: Become familiar with the best techniques for creating clear, effective, and manageable programming. Web Development Tools and Technologies: Learn to use popular tools and technologies such as Git, npm, Webpack, and TypeScript. Key Learning Outcomes Use Angular and React JS to create dynamic and responsive web-based applications. Master front-end development techniques for building user-friendly interfaces . Gain proficiency in component-based architecture . Get familiar with using Redux and NgRx to handle application state. Implement best coding practices for scalable and maintainable projects. Get hands-on experience by working on real-world projects. Why Choose Us? Industry-aligned curriculum taught by experienced instructors. Hands-on projects to implement your skills in authentic situations. Full career support , which includes help with job placement, mock interviews, and resume development. A dynamic, cooperative learning environment where students may communicate with experts and fellow learners. Flexible learning schedule to accommodate your busy life and learn at your own pace. What Roles Can React JS & Angular Web Developers Play? Front-end developer: Utilizing Angular and React JS , create dynamic and adaptable user interfaces. UI/UX Developer : Design and implement seamless user experiences on web applications. Web Application Developer : Develop dynamic web applications for various industries. Full Stack Developer : Utilize backend (BE) technologies, Angular, and React.js to manage both front-end (FE) and back-end (BE) web development tasks. Our Training Methodology Project-based learning to apply skills to real-world scenarios. Interactive sessions with experienced instructors for engaging learning. Collaborative projects to enhance teamwork and communication. Frequent assessments and feedback to facilitate continuous growth. Availability of recorded sessions for flexible learning at your own pace. Hands-on practice with popular development tools and frameworks. Personalized support from dedicated mentors. POCs, Assignments, and Quiz Every React JS & Angular Web Development course from IIT comprises tests, practical tasks, and interview preparation for each module and topic. Job Assistance Program After passing one of 3RI Technologies’ React JS & Angular Web Development courses from IIT , you can be qualified for our work support program. Real Case Studies Students can get practical experience by choosing from a variety of real-time projects with realistic use cases offered by 3RI Technologies. Free Career Counselling Chat With Us Call Us Mail Us Chat With Us Call Us Mail Us Our Industry Expert Trainer With over 10 years of combined industry experience, our trainers provide Advanced Certification in Data Science & AI curriculum with a lot of knowledge and practical competence. Our trainers are highly qualified experts with global certifications who thrive at providing hands-on, project-based learning. They use interactive sessions to ensure you get a firsthand look at real-world circumstances, which will improve your comprehension and ability to apply data science and AI tools. This strategy provides excellent instruction from professionals who are interested in your success and have abundant information. FAQ's Is this React JS & Angular Web Development course online or classroom-based? We offer an offline option for the React JS & Angular Web Development course. You can attend classes at our designated training center and benefit from in-person instruction and interaction with peers. What are the chances for a career after finishing this course? Candidates can pursue roles like Front-End Developer, Web Application Developer, and Full Stack Developer, all of which are in high demand in the tech industry. What tools will I get to learn about in this course? You will master Angular, React JS, JavaScript, HTML, and other essential front-end tools that are crucial for modern web development. Will I get placement assistance? Yes, we provide full career services, including resume building, mock interviews, and job placement support to help you succeed in your job search. Is prior programming knowledge required? Basic knowledge of JavaScript will be helpful, but the course covers everything from the basics to advanced topics, making it suitable for all skill levels. What if I miss a class? You can access recorded sessions at your convenience, ensuring you never miss a lesson and can review the material at your own pace. What types of projects will I be working on? You will work on real-world projects related to building web applications using Angular and React JS , enhancing your practical experience. What support do I get after completing the course?
